topic.angle: Zero resistance below a critical temperature

body.claim: A superconductor has a critical temperature below which its electrical resistance drops abruptly to zero.
body.why: An ordinary metal's resistance decreases only gradually as it is cooled. Heike Kamerlingh Onnes discovered superconductivity in 1911, in mercury cooled with liquid helium to 4.2 K. A current in a loop of superconducting wire can persist indefinitely with no power source, and superconducting magnets are used in MRI scanners and particle accelerators.
